Krystle D'Souza and Rida Tharana Win 'The Traitors India' Season 2

Krystle D'Souza and Rida Tharana have been crowned joint winners of 'The Traitors India' Season 2. The duo will share the prize money of Rs 66 lakh. The finale episode concluded a dramatic season filled with twists and turns.
